items.title: Prince William, Kate Middleton Mark 1st Joint Overseas Royal Tour in 4 Years
items.summary:
Prince William and wife Princess Kate Middleton have arrived in India for their first joint overseas tour in four years.

“Catherine and I are delighted to be in India for this year’s Earthshot Prize. India has made an extraordinary contribution to Earthshot over the past six years and is home to more Earthshot Finalists and Winners than any other country,” William, 44, wrote via Instagram on Monday, November 16. “It has also become one of the most exciting places in the world for environmental innovation, with people across the country developing practical solutions to some of the greatest challenges we all share.”

He added: “We look forward to meeting the innovators, entrepreneurs and young people whose ideas are helping to shape a more sustainable future,” signing the message with “W.”

The trip to Mumbai has been on William’s professional agenda since earlier this year — with Kensington Palace confirming over the weekend that Kate, 44, would be by her husband’s side as they took part in “celebrating innovation, sustainability, youth leadership and the enduring connections between the United Kingdom and India.”

Kate Middleton ‘Will Be Doing More Next Year,' Prince William Reveals 

The pair started off by visiting the Ballard Estate in Mumbai before taking part in a game of gully in the street. William wore a sleeveless jacket for the occasion while Kate rocked a green jacket with white pants.

In addition to visiting places around Mumbai, William is in India to focus on his environmental awards, the Earthshot Prize. The royal couple greeted Earthshot Prize finalists…

items.title: Which 'Virgin River' Stars Are — And Aren't — Returning After Cast Exits?
items.summary:
Virgin River is returning for season 8 after several shocking cliffhangers — yet not every cast member is confirmed to reprise their role.

The hit Netflix show, which premiered in 2019, is based on Robyn Carr ’s book series and follows the lives of residents living in a small town in Northern California. That includes nurse practitioner Mel ( Alexandra Breckenridge ) her love interest, Jack ( Martin Henderson ), his sister, Brie ( Zibby Allen ) and more. Colin Lawrence, Annette O’Toole, Tim Matheson, Benjamin Hollingsworth, Sarah Dugdale, Marco Grazzini, Mark Ghanimé and Kai Bradbury also star.

When Virgin River returned for season 7 in March 2026, showrunner Patrick Sean Smith confirmed that Marco Grazzini would not be reprising his role as Mike, telling Deadline, “He’s not coming back for season 8.”

Lauren Hammersley , who has played Charmaine since the show premiered, is also not expected to come back — at least for now.

Meet the Season 7 Cast of Netflix's Hit 'Virgin River' After Surprise Exit 

“For me, I’m just trying to look to the longevity of the show and making sure that the characters that we’re keeping have enough story engine in them to keep going,” Smith noted. “So I can’t say there are any specific cast shakeups planned, but I think we will have to start to — as characters run their course — make some decisions and bring in some new blood.”

The show was later renewed for season 9 as well.

items.title: Glenn Close Recalls Growing Up in a Cult as She Receives Honorary Oscar
items.summary:
Glenn Close is officially an Oscar winner after eight career nominations.

The All’s Fair actress, 79, received an honorary Oscar at the 2026 Governors Awards on Sunday, November 15, in the Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles.

Close was visibly emotional as she accepted the award, discussing her life growing up in what she described as a cult.

“It’s very difficult for me to process this incredible honor, because the truth is, I carry the epigenome of an outsider,” she said . “From the ages of 7 to 22, I was under the thumb of a very restrictive cult — don’t look at yourself in a mirror, no flirting, dress this way, talk this way, say it’s OK when your parents are routinely sent away from you for months on end. It meant that I was always on the outside looking in.”

Where Is Her Oscar?! Glenn Close Through the Years: Her Life in Photos 

Close went on to dedicate her award to her daughter and fellow actress, Annie Starke , and spoke about her previous brushes with Academy Awards glory.

items.title: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood
items.summary:
After years of celebrity interviews, I have learned not to be fooled by the allure of fame. We never really know them – we know what they want us to know

As I sat in Southwark crown court, listening to the final day of Russell Brand’s trial, there was one subject that came up repeatedly, invoked as often by his defence as the prosecution. I don’t mean sex or coercion, but fame. It ran through every victim impact statement and loomed so large in the courtroom that it felt as if it was almost on trial itself.

I’m an entertainment journalist who has been covering celebrities for more than 20 years – as long as Brand has been one – and I have written about him at various stages of his career. But I went to Southwark crown court as a member of the public who wanted to see justice done. For the women he had hurt, for the ones who couldn’t get as far as the courtroom, and for all of us who came of age at a time when rape culture was so fast and furious that young women mistook it for a joke that we were in on. In the age of lads’ mags, sex felt cheapened, yet somehow we were the ones who ended up paying for this. So it was doubly strange to sit in court and feel somehow complicit in it - in how this media culture had encouraged Russell Brand.

Continue reading...
items.t: I saw how brightly stars like Russell Brand could shine, but there is darkness in the shadows | Sophie Heawood
